sentences.text: The Northern Taurids are the northern branch of the same Encke stream, split in two by planetary gravity.
Encke's orbit stretches from inside Mercury's to the asteroid belt, adding fresh dust to the stream on every return.
Earth crosses this branch in mid-November; in the weeks when the two branches overlap, fireball counts rise noticeably.
At about five meteors an hour it is a quiet shower, but its slow, bright trails are a favourite of photographers.
The radiant lies just south of the Pleiades star cluster.
